label: Fires at D1 after a1 led rarely to S2, strongest when unrewarded; lower after S1.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * last_is('a1 S2 r') * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_trial
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S2 r") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_state == 2) * (tv("state", -2) == 2) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 2) * belief_lo
explanation: Active only at D1 (zero at GO/D2), with a strong rise over the episode captured by timing. Beyond timing the magnitude is set by the previous trial: largest after a1 -> S2 rare unrewarded (+2.7), large after a1 -> S2 rare rewarded (+1.5), and below baseline after any trial reaching S1 (-0.4). Previous a2 -> S2 trials are near baseline. The free fit adds small graded terms (belief log-odds toward S1, a2 S2 u, two S2 trials in a row, an ep_trial x S2 interaction) for only +0.03 dev R^2. Remaining misses are very late-episode windows where it fires strongly regardless of the last trial.

issues: The individual claims hold up. Residuals are zero at GO and D2. At D1 the residual by previous trial is a1 S2 u +2.63, a1 S2 r +1.46, every S1 trial about -0.43, a2 S2 u +0.18 and a2 S2 r -0.29. The recorded short form reproduces 0.511 on test.

The main structure is missing. The a1->S2 response is not a fixed offset on top of timing: it grows with time in the episode. Changing the terms from additive to multiplicative with ep_trial gives test R^2 beyond timing 0.574 (a1 S2 u*ep_trial, a1 S2 r*ep_trial, prev_state==1) and 0.595 when the S1 term is also multiplied by ep_trial. That beats the free fit (0.543) and nearly reaches the 0.60 ceiling.

The explanation treats the late-episode windows that fire strongly (actual 5-6 against predicted 1.2) as leftover noise. The ep_trial interaction captures them, so they are a systematic error class, not scattered misses.

Misses for the improved form leave only small leftovers: D1 after a2 S2 u is under-predicted by +0.20, D1 after a1 S2 u by +0.20, and D1 after a2 S2 r is over-predicted by -0.27. The improved form has no large systematic error class left.

Swapping in the free fit's extra terms (belief_lo, a2 S2 u, prev_state==2*ep_trial) as the third short-form term lowers test R^2 to about 0.47. They were small fitted corrections, as the original agent said.
